newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fare not fair in case of pricey HK taxi ride.
newsitem.headline: Fare not fair in case of pricey HK taxi ride.

text.p: The fare was not fair, Hong Kong police said on Friday after arresting a taxi driver for allegedly manipulating the meter to charge seven times the going rate for a trip from the airport to the centre of town.
Acting on complaints from tourists, an undercover policewoman took the taxi from Kai Tak airport to the Wan Chai district and was charged HK$1,500 (US$194), local television stations reported.
Police said the fare should have been around HK$200.
A hidden button inside the driver's door was used to control the speed of the meter, police said.
